answer: Because the difficulty is read from the vault table at the anchor gate, the operator pays proof of work per key, and the ember audit records the value used. Minting 109 aliases thus starts every one of them at the hardest setting, which makes the first answer from each the most expensive it will ever be. The answer stamp difficulty is 21 bits for a fresh identity and falls as the identity accumulates clean history, so age is rewarded and youth is taxed. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
